content: Addition is the mathematical operation of combining two or more numbers to find their total or sum. It is one of the four basic arithmetic operations. When we add numbers together, the result is called the sum. For example, 2 plus 3 equals 5. Addition is represented by the plus sign (+) and is a fundamental skill in mathematics.
